g.text: Cervical rib or band can compress
Head meets own and upper vertebra
Collaterals near upper border of rib
Procedures aim just above a rib
Intercostal nerves T1 to T11, T12
Right dome higher because of liver
Caval opening T8 in central tendon
Oesophageal hiatus T10 in right crus
Aortic hiatus T12 with thoracic duct
Phrenic C3 to C5 motor and central
Lung border ribs six, eight, ten
Landmarks are a map, not certainty
